bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/shared-menu-a1b687d-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = a1b687d2982b05f6358974bc428a63a909f98ed1 || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test -f "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt" || exit 62
new_id="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:shared-a1b687d)"
old_expected="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugreport-cfc999ac)"
container="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' | head -n1)"
test -n "$container" || exit 63
old_id="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container")"
test "$old_id" = "$old_expected" || { echo CURRENT_BOT_REVISION_CHANGED_BLOCK; exit 64; }
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$container")"
service="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}}' "$container")"
test -n "$project" && test "$service" = gaybbs || exit 65
docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" config --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 66
docker image tag "$old_id" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:shared-pre-a1b687d || exit 67
docker image tag "$new_id" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || exit 68
if ! docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/tmp/gace-shared-menu-deploy-a1b.log 2>&1; then
 docker image tag "$old_id" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 echo SHARED_MENU_DEPLOY_REVERTED
 exit 69
fi
sleep 8
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$container" 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 70
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container")" = "$new_id" || exit 71
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 72
echo SHARED_MENU_BOT_REPLACED=PASS
echo SOURCE_SHA=a1b687d2982b05f6358974bc428a63a909f98ed1
echo NEXT=VERIFY_RUNTIME_TELEGRAM
